result:
Looking at this carefully, I need to analyze each task and write qlang queries based on the language documentation provided.

Let me work through each task:

M1: Filter active users with non-null email, lowercase, sort.
M2: Average age of users with numeric ages, rounded to 1 decimal.
M3: Count users per country (case-insensitive), uppercase keys.
M4: Open issues with "bug" label (case-insensitive), sort by priority desc then id asc, get first 2 ids.
M5: Count open issues per assignee (null → "unassigned").
M6: All labels, lowercase, deduplicate, sort.
M7: Dependencies as array of {name, version} with prefix removed, sorted by name.
M8: Sum qty*price for paid or shipped orders, round to 2 decimals.
M9: Customer totals for non-cancelled orders, top 2 by spend desc then name asc.
M10: Services with tls.enabled==true, return "host:port" sorted by service name.
M11: Error count by service from logs.
M12: Services with WARN/ERROR containing "timeout".
M13: Average salary per department from CSV.
M14: Top 3 words by count from given text.

M1: filter ~(and /active (at :email | ne null)) | * (/email | lower) | sort

M2: filter ~(/profile | /age | type | eq ::number) | * /age | {sum: sum, count: count} | :data / | (/sum | div (data | /count) | round 1)

M3: filter ~(at :profile | at :country | ne null) | * (/profile | /country | upper) | groupBy * count

M4: filter ~(and (eq /state "open") (/labels | * lower | contains "bug")) | sort ~([(3 | sub /priority) /id]) | take 2 | * /id

M5: filter ~(eq /state "open") | * (at :assignee | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy * count

M6: * /labels | flat | * lower | distinct | sort

M7: /dependencies | keys | sort | * {name: /, version: (at (/ | keyword) !| (.  | apply ~(drop 1)))}

M8: filter ~(or (eq /status "paid") (eq /status "shipped")) | * (/items | * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2

M9: filter ~(ne /status "cancelled") | reduce {} ~(({((/customer | keyword)): (at (/customer | keyword) | coalesce 0 | add (/items | * (mul /qty /price) | sum))}) | reduce /0 ~(apply ~(.))) | ... | sort ~([-/total /customer]) | take 2

M10: /services | filter ~((at :tls | at :enabled) | eq true) | keys | sort | * ({host_port: (/services | at (/ | keyword) | /host | append ":" | append (at :port | coalesce 80 | print))})

M11: lines | filter ~(split " " | eq /1 "ERROR") | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy * count

M12: lines | filter ~(and (or (split " " | eq /1 "WARN") (split " " | eq /1 "ERROR")) (split " " | drop 3 | join " " | lower | contains "timeout")) | * (split " " | /2) | distinct | sort

M13: lines | drop 1 | * (split ",") | filter ~(ne /2 "") | * {dept: /1, salary: (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~/dept | * (* /salary | [sum count] | /0 | div /1 | round)

M14: "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog. The dog sleeps; the fox runs. A fox is quick." | split " " | filter ~(ne "") | * (lower) | groupBy * count | :wc / | (wc | keys | reduce [] ~(append {word: /, count: (wc | at (/ | keyword))}) | sort ~([-/count /word]) | take 3)
